old_value: {"id":"project-LICHEN-worker6-f0vn","title":"Relayed announce stores origin RX channel under immediate sender","description":"In Node._process_announce(), announce.rx_channel is signed by and describes announce.originator_iid, but line 1186 stores it as _peer_rx_channel[sender.iid]. For a relayed announce, sender is the immediate relay and differs from the originator, so origin-controlled data is misbound to the relay. _peer_has_live_state then treats that stale/misbound entry as permanent eviction protection, and entries have no expiry. Store rendezvous channel under the authenticated identity it actually describes (or do not use relayed origin data for immediate-hop channel selection) and expire/remove it consistently; test direct vs relayed announces.","status":"open","priority":2,"issue_type":"bug","owner":"me@mark.atwood.name","created_at":"2026-08-24T14:19:13.440987Z","created_by":"Mark Atwood","updated_at":"2026-08-24T14:19:13.440987Z"}
